description_en: Creates an experiment group under a specified layer. You can categorize experiment groups by experiment type to observe the overall performance of experiments by group
description_zh: 在指定层下，创建一个实验组。可按照实验类型划分实验组，从而按照实验组观测实验整体效果表现
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice create-experiment-group --layer-id 3 --name experiment_group_test --need-aa true --instance-id pairec-test1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExperimentGroup

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the experiment group
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the specified crowd for crowd targeting. You can call the ListCrowds operation to obtain the crowd ID
parameters.help_zh: 人群定向的指定人群ID，可通过接口ListCrowds获取
parameters.name: crowd_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of traffic targeting for the experiment group. Valid values:
All: All traffic.
Filter: Traffic that uses filter conditions.
CrowdId: Traffic specified by a crowd ID.
Random: Random traffic based on a percentage
parameters.help_zh:
实验组流量定向的类型，可能的取值包括：
All 所有的流量
Filter 使用过滤条件的流量
CrowdId 通过指定人群ID
Random 按照百分比随机流量
parameters.name: crowd_target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the debug crowd. You can call the ListCrowds operation to obtain the crowd ID
parameters.help_zh: 调试人群ID，可通过接口ListCrowds获取
parameters.name: debug_crowd_id

parameters.help_en: The debug users. The users must be the UIDs of Alibaba Cloud accounts or RAM users. Separate multiple UIDs with commas
parameters.help_zh: 调试用户（需为阿里云账户主账号/子账号uid），多个用户需通过逗号作间隔
parameters.name: debug_users

parameters.help_en: The description of the experiment group
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The time period for traffic distribution
parameters.name: distribution_time_duration

parameters.help_en:
The traffic distribution method. Valid values:
UserId: User ID.
TimeDuration: Time period
parameters.help_zh:
分流方式。
● UserId-用户ID
● TimeDuration-时段
parameters.name: distribution_type

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for crowd targeting
parameters.help_zh: 人群定向指定的过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the ListInstances operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the layer. You can call the ListLayers operation to obtain the layer ID
parameters.name: layer_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the experiment group
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether an AA experiment group is required
parameters.name: need_aa

parameters.help_en: The percentage of random traffic used to match the experiment group when the traffic targeting type is Random. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 当实验组流量定向的类型是Random时，使用随机流量匹配这个实验组，可能的取值范围是 0 - 100
parameters.name: random_flow

ExperimentGroupId.description_en: The ID of the experiment group
